native_stdin: UTF-8 PID LF start_token LF timeout_ms LF executable_path LF then EOF
rules: One OS process handle binds identity inspection, termination, and positive exit wait.
stopped requires the matched handle to signal after termination; request acknowledgment alone is insufficient.
absent means admitted PID could not be opened with ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER or the held handle was already signaled.
reused means start token or executable path differs; neither mismatch authorizes termination.
unverifiable means identity, access, transport, or native operation could not be established; never infer absence.
deferred means the deadline ended without positive exit proof; termination may already have occurred.
The caller owns authority for the identity and lifecycle budget. This operation does not stop descendants or discover processes.
